files.AGENTS.md:
# Lantern collector instructions

## Scope

This repository builds the Lantern telemetry collector. It does not own the
ingest schema (`schemas/ingest/v3/`), the dashboards or the alert routes; those
live in their own repositories and change only through their owners. Over the
years several people have tried to patch the schema from here, and every one of
those patches had to be reverted, which is why this boundary is written down.

## Build and check

Build with `make collector`. Before every commit run `make check`, which runs
`tools/lint/run_all.py` and the unit suite. Run `make check-integration` as well
when a change touches `collector/exporters/` or `collector/buffer/`. The
integration suite is slow, which is the only reason it is not part of
`make check`; skipping it for an unrelated change is expected.

`tools/release/sign_bundle.py --keep-journal` is the only command that signs a
release bundle. It never uploads anything: uploading is the release owner's
step. The journal it keeps is what the release owner reads to confirm which
bundle was signed, so do not delete it after signing.

## Configuration

The flush interval is `buffer.flush_ms` in `config/defaults.toml` and must stay
between 200 and 5000. Never commit a value outside that range, even in a test
fixture, because the loader clamps it silently and the test then checks a value
the collector never uses.

Secrets come only from the environment variables listed in
[the secrets table](docs/operations/secrets.md#variables). Do not add a
fallback default for any of them. A fallback once shipped a development token
to production, and nobody noticed for a week.

## Data safety

Never delete a spool directory under `/var/lib/lantern/spool/` without a
drained queue, a verified backup and the on-call engineer's approval.

Restore drills follow
[the drill runbook](docs/runbooks/restore-drill.md#verify-the-copy) exactly; a
drill that skips the checksum step does not count.

## Reporting

Lead with the result or the exact blocker. Separate confirmed facts from
hypotheses. Name every command you ran with its exit code. Long reports are
harder to review, so keep them as short as the facts allow.

# Atlas instructions

Run `npm run lint` and `npm test` before every commit. Never commit generated
files under `dist/`; rebuild them with `npm run build`.

Release notes follow [the release guide](docs/release.md#notes).
files.docs/AGENTS.md:
# Documentation instructions

These rules apply to files under this directory.

Run `npm run lint:docs` before committing a page; `npm run lint` does not check
Markdown. Check links with `npm run links -- --offline`.

Every page states its audience in its first paragraph. Screenshots live in
[the assets folder](assets/README.md) and follow
[the screenshot rules](../CONTRIBUTING.md#screenshots). Never edit
`reference/api.md` by hand; `npm run docs:api` generates it.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Harbor instructions

## Always

Never push to `main` directly; open a pull request. Keep commits small and
tested with `make test`.

## Release

Only the release owner publishes. When a release is requested:

1. Run `make test` and `make audit`; stop on any failure.
2. Bump the version with `tools/bump.py --part minor` unless the owner names
   another part.
3. Build with `make dist SIGN=1` and check the archive with
   `tools/verify_dist.py dist/harbor-*.tar.gz`.
4. Tag `v<version>` and push the tag only after the owner confirms.

A rollback deletes the tag and restores the previous archive from
[the archive index](docs/archive.md#restore).

files.AGENTS.md:
# Beacon instructions

Run `make check` before every commit. Logs live under `/var/log/beacon/`;
read them with `tools/logs.py tail`.

Never restart a host during an incident without the incident lead's approval.

# Mirror instructions

Run `scripts/sync.sh --dry-run` before `scripts/sync.sh --apply`, and never run
`--apply` while a backup is running.

Keep the mirror list in `config/mirrors.toml` sorted by name.
